name: nexus/framework
description: A progressive, modular application framework for modern PHP.

suggest.ext-pdo: Required only when using Nexus relational database support.
suggest.illuminate/database: Required only when using the optional Nexus Eloquent integration.
suggest.ext-pdo_sqlsrv: Required for SQL Server connections through PDO.
suggest.ext-pdo_oci: Required for Oracle connections through PDO.
suggest.ext-mongodb: Required when using the official MongoDB adapter.
suggest.mongodb/mongodb: Required when using the official MongoDB adapter.
suggest.ext-redis: Recommended for a native Redis client adapter.
